facts.text: I am creating a social media calendar for my business, CreativeSpark Marketing.
I want to consistently post valuable content to engage my target audience.
I just finished my business plan after several late nights and weekend sessions.
I focus on small to medium-sized businesses in the local area as my target audience.
My target audience includes busy entrepreneurs who want to grow their business but lack marketing expertise or resources to handle marketing in-house.
I want my tone and voice to be friendly, approachable, and knowledgeable.
I want to create a series of videos or blog posts about “marketing 101” topics.
I want “marketing 101” topics to include “What is SEO?” and “How to write a great social media post”.
I plan to start the first “Marketing 101” video or blog post with “What is SEO?”.
I want the first “What is SEO?” installment to be a video or blog post.
I will create a video for “What is SEO?”.
I will keep the “What is SEO?” video concise, informative, and easy to understand.
I might include animations or graphics in the “What is SEO?” video.
I will break the “What is SEO?” script down into the sections outlined earlier.
I will use simple language and relatable examples in the “What is SEO?” script.
I will keep the “What is SEO?” script conversational and friendly.
I want to measure the success of the “What is SEO?” video.
I will track views, engagement, watch time, and drop-off points for the “What is SEO?” video.
For engagement, I will ask questions or encourage viewers to share their thoughts in the comments.
I will include a clear call-to-action (CTA) at the end of the “What is SEO?” video.
My CTA will include visiting my website or signing up for a free consultation.
I will track conversion rate to see how many viewers take action.
